name: sub_prefix_hijack_basic
description: Rogue AS300 announces unauthorized more-specific /24 subnet of AS100's /16 prefix
simulated_telemetry: 2026-10-29T22:01:00Z [CRITICAL] bgpd[1042]: BGP UPDATE from peer 203.0.113.2 (AS300). Rogue AS300 is advertising unauthorized sub-prefix 10.100.1.0/24. Valid parent prefix 10.100.0.0/16 belongs to legitimate AS100. Sub-prefix hijack detected!
live_route_command:
vtysh -c 'conf t
router bgp 300
address-family ipv4 unicast
network 10.100.1.0/24
exit
end'
live_withdraw_command:
vtysh -c 'conf t
router bgp 300
address-family ipv4 unicast
no network 10.100.1.0/24
exit
end'

name: origin_hijack_unauthorized_prefix
description: Rogue AS300 announces unauthorized prefix 192.0.2.0/24 without ROA authorization
simulated_telemetry: 2026-10-29T22:05:15Z [CRITICAL] bmpd[2011]: BGP UPDATE from peer 203.0.113.2 (AS300). Origin hijack detected! Rogue AS300 is advertising unauthorized prefix 192.0.2.0/24 with no valid ROA. Malicious ingress traffic detected.
live_route_command:
vtysh -c 'conf t
router bgp 300
address-family ipv4 unicast
network 192.0.2.0/24
exit
end'
live_withdraw_command:
vtysh -c 'conf t
router bgp 300
address-family ipv4 unicast
no network 192.0.2.0/24
exit
end'
